verified: Microsoft has published a report stating that state-backed groups in China and North Korea, Salt Typhoon among them, are using the AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX, as reported by The Record.
unconfirmed: The available account does not say who developed ARTEX, whether it is custom-built or adapted from commercial tooling, which victims or sectors were targeted, how many intrusions are involved, or what indicators of compromise defenders should look for; those details rest on Microsoft's report and were not independently verified.

verified: 微软发布的报告称，中国和朝鲜的国家支持黑客组织（包括“盐台风”）已使用 AI 渗透测试工具 ARTEX 进行攻击，《The Record》根据该报告作了报道。
unconfirmed: ARTEX 的技术能力、来源与开发者，以及它被用于哪些具体入侵、造成何种后果，报道均未披露；上述归因目前只有微软一方说法，没有独立验证。

titles.en: Microsoft says Salt Typhoon and other China, North Korea groups adopt AI pentest tool ARTEX
titles.zh: 微软称中国、朝鲜黑客组织（含“盐台风”）已使用 AI 渗透测试工具 ARTEX
